_comment: Hand-written. Story names and lines for existing bosses (design/story/boss-roles.md, design/npcs/*-dialogue.md). Read by server_scripts/tt_boss_lore.js. name: boss-bar name; color: a KubeJS Text colour; intro: said once when the boss first appears; phases: said once when its health drops below 'at' (fraction); death: said when it falls. Lines go to players within 96 blocks.

mowziesmobs:ferrous_wroughtnaut.name: The Armoury Warden
mowziesmobs:ferrous_wroughtnaut.intro: &7The sealed armoury's guardian wakes. Its axe remembers the Thornwatch.

mowziesmobs:umvuthi.name: Your Hollow Self
mowziesmobs:umvuthi.intro: &8It wears your stance. It fights with your hands.
mowziesmobs:umvuthi.death: &8The Hollow face cracks. What's left of it looks almost relieved.

bosses_of_mass_destruction:lich.name: The Night Lich, Hollow General
bosses_of_mass_destruction:lich.intro: &3A crown of bone. A voice like a tomb. The siege has a commander.

cataclysm:ignis.name: Ignis, the Burning King
cataclysm:ignis.intro: &6The Burning King rises from his throne of slag.

mowziesmobs:frostmaw.name: Frostmaw
mowziesmobs:frostmaw.intro: &bBig. White. Tusks like &othis&r&b. Wren drew it smaller than it is.

cataclysm:netherite_monstrosity.name: The Choir War-Engine
cataclysm:netherite_monstrosity.intro: &4The Stranger: &o"Do try to survive it. I've grown fond of you."
cataclysm:netherite_monstrosity.death: &4The war-engine collapses. Something in its chest is still humming. Pell will want that.

cataclysm:the_harbinger.name: The Choir Herald

phases.line: &cThe Herald's song changes key. Its rail core is charging.

cataclysm:the_harbinger.death: &cThe song stops. Its rail core is intact.

cataclysm:the_leviathan.name: The Leviathan of the Sunken City
cataclysm:the_leviathan.intro: &1The Choir woke it. It is not sleeping anymore.

cataclysm:ender_guardian.name: Crucible Trial I: The Ender Guardian
cataclysm:ender_guardian.intro: &dIlsabet: &o"Each tier opens the next. Try not to be unworthy."

cataclysm:maledictus.name: Crucible Trial II: Maledictus
cataclysm:maledictus.intro: &2The second trial. It was made to be unbeatable by anyone unworthy.

cataclysm:ancient_remnant.name: Crucible Trial III: The Ancient Remnant
cataclysm:ancient_remnant.intro: &eThe last trial. The last Shard is in its keeping.

minecraft:ender_dragon.name: Malric's Bound Beast
minecraft:ender_dragon.intro: &5Malric: &o"Shard-Born. Little splinter of my Crown. Did you think you found them? They found you, for me."
minecraft:ender_dragon.death: &5Malric: &o"You cut the leash. It doesn't matter. I don't need the beast. I need you to finish what Ysolde started."

cataclysm:scylla.name: Malric, the Hollow Regent
cataclysm:scylla.intro: &5Malric: &o"So. You finally came home to me."

phases.line: &5Malric: &o"Look at your world. Ash, Hollowed, cults in stolen armour. One will, one Crown, and all of it ends."
&5Malric: &o"You were made from the Crown. You are order. Stop fighting what you are."

cataclysm:scylla.death: &5Malric: &o"Then choose. You'll find it's harder than killing me."

minecraft:wither.name: Echo of the Sundering
minecraft:wither.intro: &8The Crown is gone, but the Sundering still echoes. Something answers it.
